# X509
# @weight 15
# @timeout-scale 4

Certificates and the chains TLS servers send.  The certificates are the
real ones jrexpr.ca and github.com served on 2026-10-11, leaf first, each
with a cross-signature past its intermediate, and www.debian.org's of
2026-10-13; the roots are GTS Root R4 and USERTrust ECC from the system's
bundle and ISRG Root X1 from Mozilla's list.  The clock is held at
2026-10-15 00:00:00 UTC (1792022400), inside every leaf's validity.  The
first two paths are signed with ECDSA over P-256 and P-384, the third
with RSA throughout, and the chain checks build those engines, so the
file carries an engine's weight.

## the fixture

### the chains and the roots

```x
(do
  (import x/net/x509)
  (import x/codec/bytes)
  (def %xc-now 1792022400)
  (def %xc-jr (List map (fn (_ h) (Bytes of-hex h)) (list "" "" "")))
  (def %xc-gh (List map (fn (_ h) (Bytes of-hex h)) (list "" "" "")))
  (def %xc-roots (List map (fn (_ h) (X509 parse (Bytes of-hex h))) (list "" "")))
  (def %xc-deb (List map (fn (_ h) (Bytes of-hex h)) (list "" "" "")))
  (def %xc-isrg (X509 parse (Bytes of-hex "")))
  (def %xc-why (fn (_ thunk) (guard (e (e msg)) (thunk))))
  (write (List length %xc-roots)))
```
---
    2

## reading a certificate

### the leaf's names, dates and key

```x
(do
  (def %xc-leaf (X509 parse (first %xc-jr)))
  (write (list (X509 dns-names %xc-leaf) (X509 validity %xc-leaf) (first (X509 public-key %xc-leaf))
               (X509 signed-by? %xc-leaf (X509 parse (first (rest %xc-jr))))
               (X509 signed-by? %xc-leaf (first %xc-roots)))))
```
---
    (("jrexpr.ca" "*.jrexpr.ca") (1788650136 1796429729) 'p256 #t #f)

## chains that hold

### jrexpr.ca, by name and by its wildcard, and github.com through its cross-signature

```x
(write (list (X509 verify-chain %xc-jr "jrexpr.ca" %xc-now %xc-roots)
             (X509 verify-chain %xc-jr "WWW.jrexpr.ca" %xc-now %xc-roots)
             (X509 verify-chain %xc-gh "github.com" %xc-now %xc-roots)))
```
---
    (#t #t #t)

### www.debian.org, signed with RSA all the way to ISRG Root X1

The leaf is RSA-4096 under Let's Encrypt's YR1 (RSA-2048), YR1 under ISRG
Root YR (RSA-4096), and that under ISRG Root X1, as served on 2026-10-13.
A certificate's own issuer signs it and no one else does.

```x
(write (list (X509 verify-chain %xc-deb "www.debian.org" %xc-now (list %xc-isrg))
             (first (X509 public-key (X509 parse (first %xc-deb))))
             (X509 signed-by? (X509 parse (first %xc-deb)) (X509 parse (first (rest %xc-deb))))
             (X509 signed-by? (X509 parse (first %xc-deb)) %xc-isrg)))
```
---
    (#t 'rsa #t #f)

### a chain given parsed, or part parsed, as a TLS client that read its leaf hands it

```x
(write (list (X509 verify-chain (pair (X509 parse (first %xc-deb)) (rest %xc-deb)) "www.debian.org" %xc-now (list %xc-isrg))
             (X509 verify-chain (List map (fn (_ d) (X509 parse d)) %xc-jr) "jrexpr.ca" %xc-now %xc-roots)))
```
---
    (#t #t)

## chains that do not

### the wrong host, a wildcard two labels deep, a later date, no roots, and a leaf with another's intermediates

```x
(write (list (%xc-why (fn (_) (X509 verify-chain %xc-jr "example.com" %xc-now %xc-roots)))
             (%xc-why (fn (_) (X509 verify-chain %xc-jr "a.b.jrexpr.ca" %xc-now %xc-roots)))
             (%xc-why (fn (_) (X509 verify-chain %xc-jr "jrexpr.ca" 1811808000 %xc-roots)))
             (%xc-why (fn (_) (X509 verify-chain %xc-jr "jrexpr.ca" %xc-now ())))
             (%xc-why (fn (_) (X509 verify-chain (pair (first %xc-jr) (rest %xc-gh)) "jrexpr.ca" %xc-now %xc-roots)))))
```
---
    ("X509: the server's certificate does not name example.com" "X509: the server's certificate does not name a.b.jrexpr.ca" "X509: the server's certificate is out of date" "X509: no path to a trusted root" "X509: no path to a trusted root")

  (def %xc-ders (X509 from-pem %xc-pem))
  (write (list (List length %xc-ders) (Bytes same? (first %xc-ders) (Bytes of-hex "")))))
